patterns.note: Name the concrete dependency, constraint, or failure mode directly.
State the contrast directly instead of using a not-just-but frame.
State the insight directly; the surrounding phrase adds no content.
Describe the actual change in assumptions, models, or practice.
Use only when the clause is genuinely decisive for the claim.
Name the concrete material or start with the specific detail.
Use concrete nouns instead of figurative tapestry language.
State the point directly instead of framing it as emphasis.
Use a direct verb such as examine, inspect, or analyze.
Name the evidence directly instead of using testament-to language.
Use a more specific word for the exact concept being described.
Explain why the point matters structurally or causally.
Use a direct verb such as demonstrates, illustrates, or contains.
State the concrete property such as fast, clean, or integrated.
Name the concrete area or topic directly.

patterns.regex: \bit['’]s worth noting\b|\bit is important to note\b|\bit should be noted\b|\bit goes without saying\b|\bit['’]s no secret\b|\bthere['’]s no denying\b
patterns.note: Start with the claim; throat-clearing frames add no content.

patterns.regex: \bone might argue\b|\bit could be suggested\b|\bthe reader may notice\b|\bnot an exhaustive treatment\b|\bimportant caveats to consider\b
patterns.note: Replace hedged ritual language with the direct claim or remove it.

patterns.regex: \bstudies show\b|\bexperts agree\b|\bresearch suggests\b|\bit is widely (?:believed|regarded as)\b|\bmany argue\b
patterns.note: Cite the specific source or remove the unsupported attribution.

patterns.regex: \bin today['’]s (?:fast[- ]paced )?(?:world|digital age|competitive landscape|economy|market)\b|\bas we look ahead\b|\bwhen it comes to\b|\bat the end of the day\b|\bin conclusion\b|\bin summary\b|\bto sum up\b
patterns.note: Name the concrete situation instead of a generic framing phrase.
State the concrete technical or empirical difference.
State the positive claim directly.
Describe the specific parts or relationships that make it complex.
State the claim directly instead of reframing an earlier one as less real.
Give the comparison its own sentence, or drop it.
State what it is; the negated foil carries no information.
Open with the substance instead of announcing that substance follows.
Make the point; labelling a sentence as the point does not sharpen it.
Say the thing; announcing candour does not add it.
Lead with the conclusion instead of labelling it as the conclusion.
Answer directly. A question you immediately answer adds a turn, not content. (A question used as a heading is fine and is not matched.)
If it is worth saying, say it without the preamble.

patterns.regex: \bdoes the heavy lifting\b|\bearns? (?:its|their) (?:place|keep)\b|\bcarr(?:y|ies|ied) the weight\b|\bpulls? (?:its|their) weight\b
patterns.note: Name what the thing actually does.
